citations.description: Run log table showing 7 runs; no run shows the project move selected by the coach
Explanation of why the move was never selected: advisory move competes last against blocking built-ins

Ticket comment by RebarBotNava: 'AC5 asked for a REAL run whose output CONTAINS that move. Across four agent-tier runs the coach never SELECTED it... So the honest statement of what this story delivers is: detection demonstrated live and reliably; coaching demonstrated as OFFERED deterministically, with its appearance in any single run being a model judgement the overlay cannot guarantee. I am recording that rather than claiming AC5 as written.'

findings.criterion: a REAL `rebar review-plan` run emits the move, with the output attached as a comment on this ticket (not a unit-test-only demonstration)
findings.detail: The ticket author explicitly acknowledges AC5 is not met as written. The committed artifact docs/serena-symbol-reference-coaching-sample.md (lines 62-80) documents 7 real runs; across all agent-tier runs the coach never selected the project-symbol-reference-completeness move — it was offered (1 of 14 applicable moves in run 5) but consistently not picked by the LLM. The structural reason is documented: when the inventory is incomplete, blocking built-ins G1G2/G6/E4 also fire and Pass-4 coaches blocking findings first, so the advisory move loses selection every time. When the inventory is complete, the criterion correctly abstains. No run produced output containing the move. The AC requires the move to appear in a real run's output; that has not occurred.
findings.remediation: Either accept AC5 as amended (detection demonstrated live; coaching demonstrated as offered, with the structural limitation documented), drop this corrective half of the epic in favour of the built-ins that already block on the same evidence, or pursue a non-overlay mechanism for the method coaching. A human decision is required per the ticket's own conclusion.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
